audit.whatIsWrong: The entry credits Kayle's ranged form to her E — "E ranged form" in content mid, spikes[1].text, whys[3], wants.you[2], wants.foe[0], and "E armor-shred" in wants.foe[2].
audit.why: Her range comes from Divine Ascent, the passive, which grants Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range and eventually waves of fire as she levels and spends points. Her E is Starfire Spellblade, an auto-attack reset that adds missing-health damage. The resistance shred is on Radiant Blast, the Q. Every one of those is a different ability with a different cooldown, and the practical consequence matters: a player waiting to punish an "E" cooldown to close the range gap is waiting for something that will never come off cooldown, because the range is passive and permanent.
audit.corrected: Attributed range to Divine Ascent and shred to Radiant Blast across mid, spikes[1].text, whys[3], wants.foe[0], wants.foe[2] and tldr.
sources: champ-data/_kits/kayle.json (P Divine Ascent: Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range; Q Radiant Blast: "reducing the resistances of all hit"; E Starfire Spellblade: autoReset, missing-health damage)

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing cues. Divine Judgment is called matchup-defining in four places and never once given a number, and breakdown.cooldowns lists it twice.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s. At rank 1 that is the longest cooldown either champion has by a wide margin — baiting it is worth more than the kill it denies, because the next two minutes of lane have no invulnerability in them. Radiant Blast at 12/11/10/9/8s is her only slow and her only shred, so a sidestepped Q is the walk-up window. Both numbers turn vague respect into a plan.
audit.corrected: Replaced the duplicated cooldown entry with Divine Judgment and Radiant Blast at real numbers, and put the 160s bait logic into breakdown.mid, content mid, whys[4] and spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere, in a matchup whose plan is to chip her down for five levels.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing heals her and the nearest ally on a flat 15s cooldown at every rank, which is exactly the cadence of the level 1-5 bully pattern this entry is built on. Grievous Wounds is what makes the denied CS stick. _missing-interactions.json flags this rule for nasus vs kayle.
audit.corrected: Replaced a want line with a Grievous Wounds instruction naming the ability and its 15s cadence.
sources: champ-data/_kits/kayle.json (W Celestial Blessing, cd 15 at all ranks, heal flag)

audit.why: The chart gives Nasus levels 1-2, Skill at 3, Kayle from 4-5 through first item, then Nasus at two items. That matches a 52.64% Nasus win rate over 701 games and matches the shape of both kits: he bullies a melee Kayle, loses the stretch where her range and item spikes arrive first, and reclaims it once stacks plus Wither beat an attack-speed scaler. No change needed.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment (Invuln): matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Kayle Divine Judgment: Makes an ally INVULNERABLE briefly, then bursts around them. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — 160s at rank 1, 120s at rank 2. Bait it and the next two minutes are yours. - Kayle Radiant Blast: 12s at rank 1, her only slow and her only resist shred — sidestep it, then walk her down.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Divine Judgment (Invuln): when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve her.
edits.after: Trade strictly around Divine Judgment: at 160s on rank 1, one baited ult buys you the whole next wave cycle. If ahead, freeze and starve her.

edits.before: Scaling race — deny her CS early and out-stack her. Nasus wins by trading around Kayle's Divine Judgment (Invuln) and cashing the pattern: deny her CS and out-stack her early.
edits.after: Scaling race — deny her CS early and out-stack her. Her reach comes from Divine Ascent as she levels rather than from an ability, so the melee window is levels 1-5 and nothing after.

edits.before: Kayle is melee with no ranged form before level 6, so the first three levels are mine to bully. Every time she walks up to last-hit a cannon I load Siphoning Strike and slap her — I'm not even spending it on the minion, I'm spending it on her face, because she can't trade back without eating Soul Eater lifesteal and a stack. Spirit Fire shreds her armor and zones her off the wave so she misses CS and falls behind on her one real win condition, which is reaching her item spikes. Don't overchase past her tower — she has no escape but she's not worth a dive yet — just deny her farm and make levels 1-3 miserable.
edits.after: Kayle has no attack range from Divine Ascent yet, so the first three levels are mine to bully. Every time she walks up to last-hit a cannon I load Siphoning Strike and slap her — I'm not even spending it on the minion, I'm spending it on her face, because she can't trade back without eating Soul Eater lifesteal and a stack. Spirit Fire shreds her armor and zones her off the wave so she misses CS and falls behind on her one real win condition, which is reaching her item spikes. Don't overchase past her tower — her only out is Celestial Blessing (W) and she's not worth a dive yet — just deny her farm and make levels 1-3 miserable.

edits.before: Once Kayle hits 6 the lane flips and she takes the next stretch. Her E ranged form plus her Q slow lets her sit outside my Wither range and chip me while I have no gap-closer, and her R invulnerability blanks any all-in I commit — so don't burn ult or Wither into a Kayle who can just press R and walk it off. Levels 4-5 I keep stacking on the wave and soak her poke with lifesteal; from 6 to her first item I'm playing not to feed and racing her to my own spikes. If she dives in to trade, Wither her attack speed to nothing and Spirit Fire under her feet, but accept she owns the range game here.
edits.after: Once Kayle hits 6 the lane flips and she takes the next stretch. Divine Ascent hands her attack range as she levels, and with Radiant Blast (Q) slowing and shredding resistances she sits outside my Wither range and chips me while I have no gap-closer. Divine Judgment (R) blanks any all-in I commit — but it is 160s at rank 1, so a baited ult is worth more than the kill I gave up to bait it. Levels 4-5 I keep stacking on the wave and soak her poke with lifesteal; from 6 to her first item I'm playing not to feed and racing her to my own spikes. If she dives in, Wither her attack speed to nothing and Spirit Fire under her feet.

edits.after: Kayle's threat window opens: Radiant Blast's slow plus Divine Ascent's attack range lets her kite you, and Divine Judgment blanks your all-in on a 160s cooldown.

notes: Divine Judgment targets an ally as well as herself — it can be used to blank a dive onto her jungler, not only to save Kayle. Worth a line in dosFull/dontsFull, which I could not touch: the applier's WRITABLE_FULL regex accepts "dosFull" and "dosFull[0]" but not "dosFull[0].d", and since `after` must be a string, any dosFull edit would replace an object with a string and corrupt the entry. Same for dontsFull, focus and report. Flagging it because those blocks are visible to the player and currently cannot be corrected by any proposal. I kept the entry's existing "no ranged form before level 6" framing since it was already on disk and matches the passive's level-gated description, but the kit gives no level thresholds for Divine Ascent, so the exact level is not something I verified from disk.
